{{Quote|If we attack from above, they will have the advantage. So we will go through the rocks.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] at the start of the Battle of Bothawui|audio=GoThruTheRocks-DoaD.flac|<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />}}
An '''asteroid belt''' surrounded the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Golm]], also known as Bothawui Prime.

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|battle]] took place here during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] attempted to take his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] through the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], but the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had already placed [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]] on the rocks, ambushing the Confederacy and forcing Grievous to flee. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] gave pursuit in [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|his fighter]], but after debris hit his [[Starfighter/Legends|ship]], he was rescued by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]]. Skywalker's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], was salvaged by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]], who promised the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to Grievous. Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], later undertook a [[Ambush on the Vulture's Claw/Legends|search]] to find and retrieve R2-D2, but were unable to find the droid aboard Nachkt's ship, the [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']].<ref name="Downfall of a Droid" />
